technology_name: A FOLDED BROADBAND OPTICAL RESONATOR SPECTROMETER FOR TRACE GAS DETECTION WITH HIGH SENSITIVITY AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional trace gas detection systems require long, unmanageable physical gas cells to achieve high sensitivity thresholds, limiting field portability and deployment speed.
description: A compact, folded broadband optical resonator spectrometer utilizing an integrated multi-mirror reflection matrix to expand optical interaction path lengths inside an ultra-compact sampling chamber.
applications: Industrial greenhouse gas tracking, public safety toxic leak detection, atmospheric trace gas research, and portable stack emission monitors.
